gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Quilon shifts its weight mildly, so every stroke stays solid and readable. Noto Sans Kharoshthi, a plain sans, lays down a dark, sturdy band of lowercase with curves left open.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Quilon brings an editorial, commanding voice, its weight shimmering subtly across each word, with large open counters. Noto Sans Khmer's proud, nearly capital-sized lowercase gives that flourish a sturdy floor.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi reads like a friendly sans-serif, rounds left unlatched and capitals barely above the lowercase. And Quilon's modest weight shift across every curve is what gives the pair its character.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-kr: Quilon carries editorial swagger, its hairlines staying sturdy beside the stems. Noto Sans KR, a plain sans with stubby ascenders and a towering x-height, feels clean and contemporary beside it.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-lao: Quilon sets an editorial, commanding tone up top, its bowls thinning just slightly at the sides. Noto Sans Lao, a sans with open mouths and a lifted x-height, keeps the page modern underneath.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Noto Sans Lepcha reads sturdy, its lowercase standing tall like cast iron. Quilon leads with editorial weight shifts that are present but never dramatic, while the sans below leaves every curve wide.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu is a plain sans with gaping, open curves and tall-bodied small letters. And Quilon's thin strokes, hairline-free beside moderately weighty stems, lend this pairing its editorial edge.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Approachable describes Noto Sans Lydian, a sans-serif whose capitals barely top its lowercase. Quilon's middle-ground stroke contrast brings the editorial, commanding side, and that gap in temperament is the strongest thing about this pair.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Noto Sans Mahajani stands tall against its capitals, with a funnel-wide throat in the e. Noto Sans Mahajani, a sans-serif, would read smoothly down a whole page under Quilon.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Dense and friendly, with a middle zone that dominates each line. Noto Sans Malayalam, a plain sans with generous bends in its s, sits under Quilon, which earns its keep big and short.
